datasets.name: Perseverance landing reference point
datasets.source: Bell et al. 2023 NASA NTRS paper
datasets.note: Historic landing point; not a live rover position.

limitations: Rasters are linked as official USGS direct downloads but are not embedded because this environment could not reach the remote file host.
The GeoJSON is a study-area boundary and reference marker, not an elevation raster.
No slope raster has been generated; use the supplied script after downloading the DEM.
Slope and elevation alone cannot certify a location as safe for human survival or landing.
